title: Dallas Avionics sister company Cal Labs to offer calibration services globally for Onboard Systems field load check tool
summary: By offering this service, Cal Labs will be able to calibrate the tool and get it back to customers within seven to 10 business days.
body_markdown:
Dallas Avionics announced today at the Vertical MRO Conference in Irving, Texas, that its sister organization, Cal Labs, will now offer calibration services for the Onboard Systems hoist field load check tool globally.


“We identified that this was something needed in our industry to help expedite calibration and reduce AOG issues,” said Dallas Avionics government agency sales executive Cody Klaehn, a retired Texas DPS Aircraft tactical flight officer training lieutenant.


“Our sister company, Cal Labs, is known for its calibration of radios and other mission-critical devices. We wanted to add this to their portfolio to aid all of our existing customers.”


Dallas Avionics has been known for its offering of high-end avionics, law enforcement and communications equipment for more than 50 years. Cal Labs is housed in the same building as Dallas Avionics.


By offering this service, Cal Labs will be able to calibrate the tool and get it back to customers within seven to 10 business days.


“We’re pleased to work alongside Dallas Avionics and Cal Labs to make calibration services for our field load check tool more accessible to operators around the world,” said Onboard Systems vice president of business development Nicholas Demogines.


“Having a reliable calibration resource with a short turnaround time helps our customers keep their equipment in service and minimize disruptions to their operations. This is another step in Onboard’s continued commitment to reduce downtime, keep aircraft in the air and, ensure operators are ready to respond when lives are on the line.”


To learn more about this new service or to schedule calibration, contact Miguel Correa atmac@calllabsin.com or call 214-321-7205.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Dallas Avionics.*
